data.desc: National CineMedia, Inc. (NCM, NASDAQ:NCMI ) is a leading premium video and digital out-of-home advertising platform in the U.S. With unparalleled reach and scale, NCM, Inc.'s national network connects advertisers, through its two brands NCM and Captivate, to hard-to-reach, young, diverse and affluent audiences utilizing the power of high attention environments, including theaters, elevators and building lobbies. A premium video, full-funnel marketing solution for advertisers, NCM, Inc. enhances advertisers' ability to measure and drive results. NCM's Noovie Show is presented exclusively in 38 leading national and regional theater circuits including all three national chains, AMC Entertainment Inc. (NYSE:AMC), Cinemark Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:CNK) and Regal Entertainment Group (a subsidiary of Cineworld Group PLC ).
